data.cultural_impact: The name Siraj holds a deep cultural significance in Islamic tradition. In the context of Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was called 'Sirajun-nari', the 'Luminous Storeroom', during his miraculous journey from Mecca to Jerusalem and back to Mecca, known as Isra and Mi'raj. The name is also commonly used for mosque lamps that provide light for prayer and study.
data.spiritual_significance: Siraj is a deeply spiritual name. In Islamic tradition, it represents guiding light and wisdom from Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) himself was a source of guidance and wisdom for his followers, and he sought and provided illumination for the way forward. The name is also a reminder of Allah's endless light and guidance, which illuminates our path in this world and beyond.
